channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Hawaii's Democratic lieutenant governor indicted in state corruption investigation
item.description: A $35,000 bribe allegedly tied to a COVID-19 testing contract led to Sylvia Luke's indictment, and Gov. Josh Green is calling for her resignation.

item.title: GOP's freshman firebrand goes viral targeting 'utterly intellectually indefensible' DEI policies
item.description: Rep. Brandon Gill is the youngest House Republican and is lauded as a rising star within the party. He grilled witnesses on DEI and other ideologies.

item.title: Maine Dems Pick Troy Jackson to Face Sen. Collins
item.description: Former state lawmaker and logger Troy Jackson secured the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in Maine on Saturday.

item.title: Letitia James faces scrutiny after New York City spends $81,700 per homeless person amid shelter scandals
item.description: Saritha Komatireddy accused Letitia James of failing to investigate nonprofit homeless shelters despite billions in taxpayer funding and fraud claims.
